note: Rated stylus life is NOT a manufacturer-published figure for any entry below unless confidence says so. Every entry cites where the number came from; entries with confidence 'unknown' carry no hours and the app falls back to the generic 500 h estimate (a tunable default with no authoritative source). Nothing here was measured by DeckChek.
fallbackNote: Generic 500 h DJ estimate from FS-12 §6; forum-level evidence only, not a vendor spec.

entries.notes: Forum snippets only. About 500 h is described as realistic for DJ/back-cueing use; up to about 1000 h with proper care (an Ortofon statement relayed on a forum, not read from Ortofon directly). The per-model Concorde figure is NOT documented, so no Concorde-specific number is given.

entries.model: Jico N44-7 / J44A-7 replacement stylus (Shure M44-7 compatible)
entries.notes: Retailer quoting a vendor claim (snippet only). This is the Jico replacement stylus, not a Shure specification.
Shure's official M44-7 rating is UNKNOWN and needs verification (FS-12 §6). Do not substitute the Jico figure.
FS-12 §6 research note: a retailer snippet cites 150-200 h for elliptical styli. The page URL was not recorded, so this is unverified; the lower bound is used.
FS-12 §6 research note: about 500 h before inspection, up to 1000 h, from a forum (URL not recorded). Unverified; the lower bound is used.
